title: Metaphysics — Timeline
summary: This document gives a compact *timeline* of major figures in metaphysics side-by-side with a *problem map* (ontology, identity and change, space & time, causation, modality, mind & body, universals & particulars, free will, the absolute). It synthesizes standard reference scholarship and classic texts.

content_html:
Metaphysics — Timeline

Core Questions

  • Ontology: What exists? What is fundamental?
  • Identity & Change: Persistence through change; Ship of Theseus.
  • Space & Time: Substantival vs. relational; phenomenological time.
  • Causation: Powers, regularities, counterfactuals; Hume’s critique.
  • Modality: Possibility/necessity; possible worlds and essences.
  • Mind & Body: Dualism, physicalism, panpsychism.
  • Universals & Particulars: Properties, realism vs. nominalism.
  • Free Will: Compatibilism vs. libertarianism vs. hard determinism.
  • God / Absolute: Necessary being, process, immanence/transcendence.
